name: Topaz Image Upscale
description: Upscale and enhance images with Topaz Labs models. One endpoint; the `model` request field picks the enhancement model (Standard V2 by default), priced per image up to 24MP output. The standard family keeps the original flat price; the generative family (redefine, standard-max, wonder, wonder-3, wonder-3.5) adds synthesized detail at a higher rate.

image_url.description: URL of the image to upscale.
image_url.title: Image Url

upscale_factor.description: How much to enlarge the image: 2x, 3x, or 4x the original dimensions.
upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor

model.description: Topaz enhancement model. Standard family (true-to-input upscaling): `standard-v2` (default, general purpose), `low-resolution-v2` (small/degraded sources), `cgi` (art and CGI), `high-fidelity-v2` (detail preservation), `text-refine` (text and shapes). Generative family (adds synthesized detail, priced higher): `redefine` (prompt-driven), `standard-max`, `wonder`, `wonder-3`, `wonder-3.5`.
model.title: Model

output_format.description: Output image format; omitted keeps the provider default (jpeg).
output_format.title: Output Format

crop_to_fill.description: When the output aspect ratio differs, crop to fill the output dimensions instead of the default letterboxing.
crop_to_fill.title: Crop To Fill

subject_detection.description: Where enhancements are applied; omitted lets Topaz auto-configure.
subject_detection.title: Subject Detection

face_enhancement.description: Apply Topaz's face recovery model. When true, `face_enhancement_strength` and `face_enhancement_creativity` are required. Omitted lets Topaz auto-configure.
face_enhancement.title: Face Enhancement

face_enhancement_creativity.description: Realistic (0) to creative (1) face recovery (requires face_enhancement=true).
face_enhancement_creativity.title: Face Enhancement Creativity

strength.description: Overall model strength (standard models only); too high can look unrealistic.
strength.title: Strength

prompt.description: Describe the desired result for generative models (not wonder-3/wonder-3.5); descriptive statements work better than directives. Cannot be combined with autoprompt=true.
prompt.title: Prompt

autoprompt.description: Auto-generate the guidance prompt (generative models except wonder-3/wonder-3.5; replaces `prompt`).
autoprompt.title: Autoprompt

creativity.description: Generative creativity 1-9 (generative models only); lower stays truest to the input.
creativity.title: Creativity

texture.description: Generative texture detail 1-5 (generative models only); 1 at low creativity, 3 at higher.
texture.title: Texture

detail.description: Add post-render detail (generative models only). When true, `detail_strength` is required.
detail.title: Detail

enhancement_strength.description: Enhancement level (wonder-3 and wonder-3.5 only); omitted lets Topaz auto-configure.
enhancement_strength.title: Enhancement Strength
